body:
# Stock Vein
(this is for the updated version 0.2 NOT below) 
Stock Vein is a server-side Minecraft stock market plugin that adds a full fake in-game stock economy to your server. Players can buy and sell fictional Minecraft-style companies, track their portfolio, view stock info, invest in ETFs, follow market news, earn dividends, set alerts, and react to market events through a clean GUI.

The plugin is made for servers that want a deeper economy system without using real stocks, real crypto, real money, client mods, or a resource pack. Everything in Stock Vein is fake in-game gameplay.

## What Is Stock Vein?

Stock Vein turns your Minecraft server economy into a fake stock market. Players can open `/stocks` and trade fictional companies with Minecraft-themed names, sectors, prices, risk levels, dividends, events, and market movement.

The market changes over time from passive movement, news, reports, sector activity, IPOs, stock splits, mergers, bankruptcies, and other market events.

Players can choose to invest safely in stable dividend stocks, take risks on volatile companies, or buy ETFs/index funds that represent groups of stocks.

## Main Features

### Stock Trading

Players can buy and sell shares of fake Minecraft-style companies.

Features include:

- Buy stocks
- Sell stocks
- Track owned shares
- View stock value
- View price movement
- View stock risk
- View stock sector
- View stock info
- View fake ASCII stock graphs
- See recent movement and market status

Stock Vein is made to feel like a stock market, but simplified enough for Minecraft players to understand.

### 200 Fictional Stocks

Stock Vein includes 200 fictional companies with Minecraft-style names and market themes.

Stocks can belong to sectors such as:

- Tech
- Redstone
- Water/Ocean
- Farming/Food
- Mining
- Materials
- Energy
- Finance
- Retail
- Transport
- Media
- Gaming
- Health
- Security
- Real Estate
- Industrial
- Utilities
- Aerospace

These sectors help organize the market and make it easier for players to find the type of stock they want.

### Clean GUI

Stock Vein uses a GUI-based system so players do not have to memorize every command.

The main `/stocks` menu includes sections for:

- Market
- Portfolio
- Stock Info
- Sectors
- ETFs
- IPOs
- Reports
- Alerts
- Dividends
- Tutorial
- Help

The GUI is designed to be simple, readable, and easy for new players to understand.

### Player Portfolios

Each player has their own stock portfolio.

Players can view:

- Cash balance
- Owned stocks
- Shares owned
- Current stock value
- Total portfolio value
- Dividend earnings
- Stock performance

This gives players a reason to keep checking the market and improving their investments.

### Stock Info Pages

Each stock has its own information page.

Stock info can show:

- Ticker symbol
- Company name
- Sector
- Risk level
- Current price
- Price movement
- Owned shares
- Dividend info
- Market status
- Graph page
- Buy/sell buttons
- Alert options

This makes it easier for players to understand a stock before buying it.

### Fake ASCII Graphs

Stock Vein includes fake ASCII-style stock graphs inside the GUI.

These graphs help players see price movement without needing a website, map art, resource pack, or client mod.

Graphs are simple and made to fit Minecraft item lore.

### Sectors and Categories

Players can filter stocks by sector.

Examples:

- Tech stocks
- Water/Ocean stocks
- Food/Farming stocks
- Mining stocks
- Finance stocks
- Energy stocks
- Dividend stocks
- High-risk stocks

This is useful because the plugin includes many stocks, and sectors make the market easier to browse.

### ETFs and Index Funds

Stock Vein includes ETF/index fund style investments.

ETFs are groups of stocks bundled into one investment.

Examples:

- Whole market index
- Tech index
- Ocean/water index
- Farming/food index
- Mining index
- Energy index
- Safer dividend index

ETFs are useful for players who do not want to pick individual stocks and would rather invest in a group of companies.

### IPO System

Stock Vein includes an IPO system.

An IPO is when a new company enters the public stock market.

Admins can create and launch new IPOs. This allows server owners to add new companies over time and make the market feel alive.

### Dividends

Some stocks can pay dividends.

Dividends reward players for holding certain stocks over time. This gives players a reason to invest long-term instead of only buying and selling quickly.

Dividend features include:

- Weekly dividend payouts
- Dividend info in the GUI
- Player dividend tracking
- Safer stocks can be used as dividend stocks

### Market Reports

Stock Vein can generate market reports.

Reports help players understand what is happening in the market.

Reports can include:

- Market performance
- Top gainers
- Top losers
- Sector movement
- Weekly market summary
- Important market changes

This makes the market easier to follow, especially for newer players.

### Market News and Events

The market can be affected by news and events.

Examples of events:

- Tech boom
- Ocean trade surge
- Mining collapse
- Food shortage
- Energy crisis
- Market crash
- Sector growth
- Company news
- IPO launch
- Stock split
- Merger
- Bankruptcy

Events make the market feel active instead of random.

### Price Alerts

Players can set price alerts.

Examples:

```text
/stocks alert STONE above 150
/stocks alert REDW below 60
